inputs.text: Man, these two middle school brothers in Michigan got forced to yank off their hoodies with "Let’s Go Brandon" on them after the school called it profane and the lower courts backed the move. Now it's heading to the U.S. Supreme Court with the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression saying their First Amendment rights got violated. This slogan kicked off in 2021 at a NASCAR event where the crowd was actually yelling "F*** Joe Biden!" but the NBC interviewer fed racer Brandon Brown the line that it was "Let’s Go Brandon!" instead. This has nothing to do with any real school rule on bad language. It's the elites and institutions coordinating to crush open pushback against the official story by slapping a profane label on it and using schools and courts to shut it down. They're twisting everything to shield their narrative and keep people from catching what the crowd was really saying.
